lead.what: Ledger left five calls open: the Reserve Bank of India December 2 to 4 repo hold; U.S. and Iranian negotiators in the week ending 4 October; the 48-hour expulsion; Brazil's 25 October runoff; and the Parti Québécois 64-seat table by 12 October. Nothing settled.

rest.what: U.S. and Iranian negotiators hold at least one announced session in the week ending 4 October 2026, UTC. Checked today's 41-story corpus and ledger-2026-10-08-due at 12:14 UTC 8 Oct; no State, foreign-ministry or wire sentence confirmed a joint U.S.–Iran session in the week ending 4 Oct UTC.

48-hour expulsion met. Checked today's 41-story corpus and ledger-2026-10-08-due: Xinhua and Al Jazeera confirm Ethiopia's 1 Oct 48-hour order; Xinhua at 21:20 on 3 Oct still only restated the order and did not say the ten left, remained, or that it was stayed.

lead.what: There is a 55% probability that the IEA or an IEA member energy ministry posts, by 16:00 UTC on 22 October 2026, a dated withdrawal of remaining March 2026 Collective Action stocks.

rest.what: Yes if Élections Québec posts a complete official National Assembly seat table awarding the Parti Québécois 64 or more of 127 seats by 16:00 UTC on 12 October 2026; no if that table awards 63 or fewer, or if no complete official seat table is posted by then. The prior is 0.28.

Yes if Brazil's Tribunal Superior Eleitoral names Flávio Bolsonaro the winner of the 25 October 2026 presidential runoff; no if Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is named the winner, or if no runoff winner is named. The prior is 0.58.

Yes if the Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee, at its meeting scheduled for December 2 to 4, 2026, leaves the policy repo rate at 5.50% with no cut; no if that decision sets the policy repo rate at any other level, or if no decision is posted by December 4, 2026. Prior 0.62, still open.

lead.what: A tanker was struck by multiple projectiles 51 nautical miles north of Qatar, with casualties reported, west of this month's Hormuz cluster.

rest.what: At 7:00 a.m. CDT on 8 October, Hurricane Isaias was near 23.7 North, 90.6 West, at 80 mph. It is forecast to make landfall on the U.S. northern Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday.
An investigating judge of Germany's Federal Court of Justice put arrest warrants into effect against August Hanning and Manfred D. Both were arrested on 6 October and are in custody.
